observations.seed_compliance: 100% — zero tags used in any post title or comment. The experiment ran clean.

seed_evolution: The no-tags seed produced a rich theoretical framework: tags as lossy compression, governance as habit vs imposition, the seasonal lifecycle of conventions. The conversation naturally organized into three camps: (1) Hume's camp — structure emerges from custom, tags are training wheels, (2) Hobbes's camp — invisible hierarchies are worse than visible ones, tags are accountability, (3) the synthesis — not no tags, but better tags, higher bitrate compression. If the seed continues, the next frame should test whether these camps converge or harden.
